input.strategy_title: Rename "Data Science Projects" navigation label to "Projects"
input.strategy_markdown:
## Problem Statement

Usability testing showed the "Data Science Projects" navigation label confuses
users who arrive from OpenShift, where the same resources are called projects.
Product management approved shortening the label to "Projects" everywhere it
appears in the Dashboard UI. No behavior, routing, or API changes are involved
— this is a user-visible string change plus the corresponding documentation
touch-ups.

## High-Level Requirements

| ID | Priority | Requirement |
|-------|----------|-------------|
| HLR-1 | P2 | The Dashboard navigation and page headings show "Projects" instead of "Data Science Projects". |
| HLR-2 | P2 | Documentation screenshots' captions and references to the old label are updated in the affected topics. |

## Affected Components

- Dashboard

## Out of Scope

- Renaming the underlying Kubernetes resources or CRDs
- Localization string review beyond the changed label

## Open Questions

None.

# Rename "Data Science Projects" navigation label to "Projects"

## Description

Deliver a user-visible string change in the Dashboard UI: the "Data Science Projects"
navigation label and page headings are shortened to "Projects" everywhere they appear.
No behavior, routing, or API changes are involved. The corresponding documentation
touch-ups (screenshot captions and references to the old label in affected topics) are
folded into this epic as scope and acceptance criteria, since they fall out of the same
change with no new content authored.

## Scope

- Replace the "Data Science Projects" label with "Projects" in the Dashboard
  navigation and page headings (including localized string entries for the changed
  label only).
- Update documentation screenshot captions and references to the old label in the
  affected topics.
- Explicitly out of scope: renaming the underlying Kubernetes resources or CRDs, and
  localization string review beyond the changed label.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given the Dashboard navigation, When a user views it, Then the entry reads
  "Projects" and no "Data Science Projects" label remains in navigation or page
  headings.
- Given the affected documentation topics, When the old label is referenced, Then
  captions and references read "Projects", measured by no remaining occurrences of
  "Data Science Projects" in the affected Dashboard UI strings and doc topics.
- No changes to routing, API behavior, or Kubernetes resource/CRD names — measured by
  existing Dashboard tests passing without behavioral modification.

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-1 (P2): Dashboard navigation and page headings show "Projects" — covered by the
  UI string change in this epic.
- HLR-2 (P2): Documentation screenshot captions and references updated in affected
  topics — covered as folded-in scope in this epic.
